title: Polars quality check
subtitle: A small-data alternative
description: Use real Polars in the trusted local Python worker when the optional package is installed. It never pretends to be Spark.

steps.title: Filter and aggregate with Polars
steps.code:
import polars as pl
orders = pl.DataFrame(query("SELECT * FROM source.orders"))
result = orders.filter(pl.col("net_amount") > 0).group_by("customer_id").agg(pl.col("net_amount").sum().alias("revenue"), pl.len().alias("orders"))
display(result)
steps.solution:
import polars as pl
orders = pl.DataFrame(query("SELECT * FROM source.orders"))
result = orders.filter(pl.col("net_amount") > 0).group_by("customer_id").agg(pl.col("net_amount").sum().alias("revenue"), pl.len().alias("orders"))
display(result)
steps.concept: Polars is an actual local execution engine, not a simulated distributed cluster.

check.sql: SELECT customer_id, revenue, orders FROM gold.customer_revenue ORDER BY customer_id
